describes: Data-only naming of the reasoning dimensions a deontic norm's content can be carried on. This is vocabulary, not a binding: deontic declares no dispatch framework and imports no dimension type. Round 5: an operator (O, P, F) carries no 5D dimension, in any form or under any name — the 5D describes what IS, and an operator is OUGHT, not a fact on that manifold; no consumer projects an operator onto a dimension, at any seam. A norm's factual side is its regulated action, entered into the versum as its own action-type entry (a concept in its own right, never asserted as the norm) and linked to the norm by a structural 'embeds' link; it is that action-type entry's content, never the operator, that may be carried on one of the axes named below. This file only names those axes, so such a projection can be validated against a shared list. The operator→dimension map does not live here, under any name.

dimensions.name: temporal
dimensions.gloss: bounded or dated in time (deadlines, resolutive conditions)
